usageNotes: Returns the directory index of available sub-resources (subdirectories) for a specific SDN fabric on a given node — useful for discovering what status or configuration endpoints are available under that fabric. Requires SDN.Audit permission on /sdn/fabrics/{fabric}; the fabric must already exist and the node must be online. This is a navigation endpoint, not a status endpoint — follow the returned 'subdir' links to fetch actual fabric data.

examples.summary: List available sub-resources for SDN fabric 'vxlan01' on node 'pve1'

tips: The fabric ID must be 2–8 alphanumeric characters with internal hyphens allowed (e.g. 'vx01', 'evpn-dc'); single-character IDs are rejected.
The response is a directory index — each object contains a 'subdir' field pointing to a child resource. Use those paths to retrieve actual fabric status or peer information.
SDN fabric support requires the Proxmox SDN plugin to be configured; if no fabrics exist, this endpoint will return 404.
